content: औशीरम् [उशीरं-अण्] .²1 The handle of a fan or Chowri. .²2 A bed; औशीरे कामचारः कृतोऽभूत् <ls>Dk. 72</ls> at liberty to sleep or sit. .²3 A seat (chair, stool <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 An unguent made of Uśīra; अचन्दनमनौशीरं हृदयस्यानुलेपनम् <ls>Mk. 10. 23</ls>. .²5 The root of the fragrant grass उशीर <ab>q. v.</ab> .²6 A fan. --{%a.%} made from उशीर; छत्रं वेष्टनमौशीरम् <ls>Mb. 12. 60. 32</ls>.
